snip.t: *After reading this note you will be able to recognise, grade and initiate safe emergency management of thyroid storm and myxoedema coma, while knowing which local protocols (Kenya MoH & hospital formulary) must be consulted for drug choices and dosing.*

Myxoedema coma – the extreme end of untreated or undertreated hypothyroidism presenting with profound metabolic depression, hypothermia, and altered consciousness, often triggered by infection, drugs or systemic illness.
